query:
SELECT
                id          AS "id!: Uuid",
                project_id  AS "project_id!: Uuid",
                node_id     AS "node_id!: Uuid",
                document_id AS "document_id!: Uuid",
                rationale,
                confidence,
                created_at  AS "created_at!"
            FROM kb_edges
            WHERE project_id = $1
              AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR node_id = $2)
              AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR document_id = $3)
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
